how: We read the website of every Miami wedding DJ listed on Lazo (87 listings, 53 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: equipment rental houses, AV production companies, a Tampa DJ company with a Miami landing page, and a Thumbtack profile. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
Do you do bilingual English and Spanish MC work, and how do you handle hora loca if we want one?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: DJ Phil Santos
picks.blurb: Phil Santos has been spinning since 2012 and runs Honey DJ Entertainment as an elevated wedding DJ service based in Miami, with curated mixes and a backstory about finding his people at concerts. Packages and enhancements are priced on the site.

picks.name: Icon DJ
picks.blurb: Owner-operated by Ethan Stone: you plan with Ethan and Ethan is behind the decks, one person from the first call to the last song. Icon DJ learns what you do not want played, then watches the room and adjusts, with photo booths, uplighting and LED walls as add-ons.

picks.name: DJs Miami FL
picks.blurb: Founded in 2014 and run by its owner from Miami Beach, DJs Miami FL keeps a roster of around twelve bilingual English and Spanish DJs and MCs covering Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach, from the Keys up. The site quotes rates from $95 an hour.

picks.name: Sound Event DJs
picks.blurb: Jorge Antonatos has worked in music and weddings since 2000 and established Sound Event DJs in 2013, with his wife Monica joining in 2017. Multiple DJs, musicians and family members on staff, plus photo booths, 360 booths, lighting and flower walls.

picks.name: All Events Dj Services
picks.blurb: Originally South Florida DJs, All Events has provided personalized DJ and MC services across South Florida since 1998 and is best known for wedding receptions. The site pitches itself as the affordable wedding DJ and advises meeting the DJ who will actually work your event.

picks.name: Miami Wedding DJ - DJ Jonny 5
picks.blurb: Over 25 years of DJ, MC and audio-visual production for Florida weddings and corporate events, with customized playlists and a range of packages and enhancements laid out on the site. Jonny 5 works events in Florida exclusively.

picks.name: Mix DJs Entertainment
picks.blurb: The Mix DJs sells one team and one plan: wedding DJs and MCs plus uplighting, monograms, photo booths, LED robots, drummers and hora loca packages for Miami, Fort Lauderdale and the Florida Keys. The site carries planning resources, song lists and a planner form.

picks.name: Vision DJs, Lighting & Photo Booths
picks.blurb: A single customizable package instead of tiers, covering DJs, MC services, event lighting, special effects and photo booths across Miami, Broward, Palm Beach and the Florida Keys. Vision DJs works weddings, quinces and corporate events.

picks.name: REmixed Events
picks.blurb: South Florida's female DJ company, started by DJ ReRe and now a roster of female DJs, hosts and event pros for luxe weddings, brand events and yacht parties. REmixed Events promises good music, pretty setups and no awkward moments.

picks.name: Dj Shaq Fx - Israeli DJ in Miami | Jewish Dj Weddings | Bar Bat MItzvah & Events
picks.blurb: An international DJ who owned a company of 12 DJs in Israel and was musical director for Tel Aviv venues, now playing Jewish weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs and events in South Florida. DJ Shaq FX also books live performances.

picks.name: DJ Pedro Acevedo (DJ Pace)
picks.blurb: Over three decades as a bilingual DJ in West Palm Beach and Palm Beach County, DJ Pace covers weddings, quinceaneras and corporate events with music, MC services and audiovisual support from intimate gatherings to large productions.

picks.name: Kenny Mondo Productions
picks.blurb: Celebrating 37 years of DJs and MCs in Palm Beach County, Kenny Mondo Productions says about 90 percent of its clients are repeat customers or word-of-mouth referrals, and puts reputation at the top of its list. Uplighting is available.
